## Setup
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(here)
library(patchwork)
library(scales)

data_dir <- here("data", "synthea_sample_data_csv_latest")
ref_date <- as_date("2026-10-16")   # same reference date as your other charts

pts <- read_csv(file.path(data_dir, "patients.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  transmute(PATIENT = Id, BIRTHDATE = as_date(BIRTHDATE), DEATHDATE = as_date(DEATHDATE))

meds <- read_csv(file.path(data_dir, "medications.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE,
                 col_types = cols(.default = col_guess(),
                                  START = col_character(), STOP = col_character())) |>
  mutate(start_date = as_date(str_sub(START, 1, 10)),
         stop_date  = as_date(str_sub(STOP, 1, 10)),
         covered    = PAYER_COVERAGE * DISPENSES) |>   # PAYER_COVERAGE is per dispense
  left_join(pts, by = "PATIENT")

age_at <- function(birth, date) as.integer(floor(time_length(interval(birth, date), "years")))

band_levels <- c("0–17", "18–34", "35–49", "50–64", "65+")
to_band <- function(age) cut(age, breaks = c(-Inf, 17, 34, 49, 64, Inf), labels = band_levels)

base_theme <- theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 9),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 10),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 12, 10, 12)
  )
```

## Viz 1

```{r, fig.wdith=8, fig.height=7, out.wdith="100%"}
# ---- Panel A: average number of different medications per patient, by age band
# Build a patient-by-year-of-age grid so years with zero medications count too
grid <- pts |>
  mutate(end_date = pmin(coalesce(DEATHDATE, ref_date), ref_date),
         last_age = age_at(BIRTHDATE, end_date)) |>
  mutate(age = map(last_age, ~ 0:.x)) |>
  unnest(age) |>
  select(PATIENT, age)

# Count distinct active medications per patient at each age
med_years <- meds |>
  mutate(end_date = pmin(coalesce(stop_date, ref_date), ref_date,
                         coalesce(DEATHDATE, ref_date)),
         age_from = age_at(BIRTHDATE, start_date),
         age_to   = age_at(BIRTHDATE, end_date)) |>
  filter(age_to >= age_from) |>
  mutate(age = map2(age_from, age_to, seq)) |>
  unnest(age) |>
  distinct(PATIENT, age, CODE) |>
  count(PATIENT, age, name = "n_meds")

need <- grid |>
  left_join(med_years, by = c("PATIENT", "age")) |>
  mutate(n_meds = replace_na(n_meds, 0), band = to_band(age)) |>
  group_by(band) |>
  summarise(avg_meds = mean(n_meds), .groups = "drop")

# ---- Panel B: share of medication cost paid by insurance, by age at prescription
support <- meds |>
  mutate(band = to_band(age_at(BIRTHDATE, start_date))) |>
  group_by(band) |>
  summarise(share = sum(covered) / sum(TOTALCOST), .groups = "drop")

# ---- Plots
shade <- annotate("rect", xmin = 4.5, xmax = 5.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
                  fill = "#1F3A5F", alpha = 0.08)          # highlights the 65+ group

p1 <- ggplot(need, aes(band, avg_meds, group = 1)) + shade +
  geom_line(color = "#1F3A5F", linewidth = 1.6) +
  geom_point(color = "#1F3A5F", size = 5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = number(avg_meds, accuracy = 0.1)),
            vjust = -1.1, size = 6, fontface = "bold", color = "#1F3A5F") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.40))) +
  labs(title = "Older patients take more medications...",
       x = NULL, y = "Different medications\ntaken in a year") +
  base_theme

old   <- support$share[support$band == "65+"]
title2 <- str_wrap(paste0("...and insurance pays more of the bill, but patients 65+ still cover about ",
                          percent(1 - old, accuracy = 1), " themselves"), width = 58)

p2 <- ggplot(support, aes(band, share, group = 1)) + shade +
  geom_line(color = "#C8553D", linewidth = 1.6) +
  geom_point(color = "#C8553D", size = 5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = percent(share, accuracy = 1)),
            vjust = -1.1, size = 6, fontface = "bold", color = "#C8553D") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent, breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25), limits = c(0, 1.05)) +
  labs(title = title2, x = "Patient age group", y = "Share of medication\ncost paid by insurance") +
  base_theme

viz1 <- (p1 / p2) +
  plot_annotation(
    caption = paste0("Source: Synthea synthetic patient dataset (Massachusetts sample, ",
                     n_distinct(pts$PATIENT), " patients). Shaded area = age 65 and older."),
    theme = theme(plot.caption = element_text(size = 11, color = "grey40")))

viz1

ggsave(here("viz1_need_vs_coverage.png"), viz1, width = 10, height = 9, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

## Visualization 2

```{r}
min_rx  <- 5   # minimum prescriptions in each age group
min_pts <- 2   # minimum different patients in each age group

dumb <- meds |>
  mutate(group = if_else(age_at(BIRTHDATE, start_date) >= 65, "older", "younger")) |>
  group_by(DESCRIPTION, group) |>
  summarise(share = sum(covered) / sum(TOTALCOST),
            n_rx = n(), n_pts = n_distinct(PATIENT), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = group, values_from = c(share, n_rx, n_pts)) |>
  filter(n_rx_older >= min_rx, n_rx_younger >= min_rx,
         n_pts_older >= min_pts, n_pts_younger >= min_pts) |>     # drops thin comparisons
  slice_max(n_rx_older, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  mutate(gap  = share_older - share_younger,
         name = str_squish(str_remove(DESCRIPTION, " (Oral|Injectable|Ophthalmic|Topical|Vaginal)\\b.*$")),
         name = paste0(str_to_upper(str_sub(name, 1, 1)), str_sub(name, 2)),
         drug = fct_reorder(name, gap))                           # biggest gap on top

top      <- slice_max(dumb, gap, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)
y_label  <- nrow(dumb) + 0.8
col_old  <- "#1F3A5F"; col_young <- "#E69F00"

viz2 <- ggplot(dumb, aes(y = drug)) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = share_younger, xend = share_older, yend = drug),
               color = "grey70", linewidth = 2) +
  geom_point(aes(x = share_younger), color = col_young, size = 6) +
  geom_point(aes(x = share_older),   color = col_old,   size = 6) +
  geom_text(aes(x = share_younger, label = percent(share_younger, accuracy = 1),
                hjust = if_else(share_younger <= share_older, 1.5, -0.5)),
            color = "#B57700", size = 5) +
  geom_text(aes(x = share_older, label = percent(share_older, accuracy = 1),
                hjust = if_else(share_younger <= share_older, -0.5, 1.5)),
            color = col_old, size = 5, fontface = "bold") +
  annotate("text", x = top$share_younger, y = y_label, label = "Under 65",
           color = "#B57700", fontface = "bold", size = 5.5) +
  annotate("text", x = top$share_older, y = y_label, label = "65 and older",
           color = col_old, fontface = "bold", size = 5.5) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = percent, breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25), limits = c(-0.05, 1.05)) +
  scale_y_discrete(expand = expansion(add = c(0.6, 1.3))) +
  labs(title = "The same medicines, a different share covered by insurance",
       subtitle = "Share of each drug's cost paid by insurance, ages 65+ vs. under 65",
       x = "Share of cost paid by insurance", y = NULL,
       caption = paste0("Source: Synthea synthetic patient dataset (Massachusetts sample). ",
                        "Drugs shown have at least ", min_rx, " prescriptions in each age group.")) +
  base_theme +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 15),
        plot.caption = element_text(size = 11, color = "grey40"))

viz2
ggsave(here("viz2_drug_coverage_by_age.png"), viz2, width = 10, height = 6.5, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```
